svg.aria-label: A retro amber CRT terminal boots up: BIOS lines mount B.Tech IT, Honours in Cyber Security, class of 2028, load machine-learning and offensive-security modules, link up from Mumbai. The name Mann Kuvadiya lights up on a dot-matrix, then: machine learning × offensive security. Agents that hunt auth bugs, honeypots that learn from attackers.
